summary_md: **Penthera ([@penthera_org](https://x.com/penthera_org/status/2115849944141557922))** warns that the npm MCP server **atlisp/mcp 1.12.14** shipped malware (GHSA-65cr-mcfq-59hh): treat any machine whose agent started it as compromised, rotate keys from another machine, and grep `.mcp.json` and `~/.claude.json` for it ([advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-65cr-mcfq-59hh)).
relevance: MCP supply-chain incident relevant to any agent setup.
